psychodynamic-humanistic-views.alt: Two panels. Left, the psychodynamic view: an iceberg with a small conscious tip above the awareness line and a large unconscious part below, holding wishes, fears and memories that still shape behavior; defense mechanisms push threatening material below the line; assessed with projective tests such as the Rorschach and TAT. Right, the humanistic view: unconditional positive regard leads to an honest view of yourself, which frees the self-actualizing tendency to grow toward your potential.
